weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (8), Kill (4), Airburst (2) and Homing Special Rule. Secondary Armament of the UNSC M9 Wolverine Anti-Aircraft Tank. Can’t be detonated within 10 Meters of the weapon used to fire the Grenade.

weapons.name: M460 Auto Grenade AGL
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. EMP (4), Blast (8), Kill (4) Special Rule. Secondary Armament of the UH-144A Falcon. Capable of two detonation types. When the trigger is held after firing it may only fire once per Round and the Grenade will not detonate until released. The Grenade has proximity sensors that track IFF Tags and will display a counter of friendlies and enemies within the Blast Radius. When held, the M460 gains the EMP (4) Special Rule. When the trigger is not held, the Grenade will detonate after 6 Seconds of being fired. The Grenade detonates on impact. Can’t be detonated within 10 Meters of the weapon used to fire the Grenade.

weapons.name: M454 Ion Bomb Ion Bomber
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Recharge (1), Blast (8), Kill (4), Homing Special Rule. Secondary Armament of the UNSC Hannibal Wasp. Homing Special Rule. Can’t be detonated within 10 Meters of the weapon used to fire the Grenade.

weapons.name: KG Mark 34 Flame Mortar Flame Mortar
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Flame (1D10), Blast (8), Homing Special Rule. Secondary Armament of the UNSC Hannibal Wasp. Homing Special Rule. Can’t be detonated within 10 Meters of the weapon used to fire the Grenade.

weapons.name: NA6 Defoliant Projector Heavy Hellbringer
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Flame (1D10), Spread Special Rule. Fires a sticky flammable set of chemicals that are then ignited. Releases a 45-degree cone of fire that hits multiple targets. Point Blank Attacks with a Flamethrower causes the User to hit themselves with the Attack, as well.

weapons.name: X54-2 Coldsnap Launcher Coldsnap
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cryo (6), Blast (9), Kill (3). When against Vehicles up to 6 Size Points, will reduce the Vehicles Acceleration and Top Speed by 4D10 MpT per Turn struck.

weapons.name: M343A3 Needler 343A-N
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Needle (5) Special Rule. Has a Shield that gives +6 Armor from Attacks that would hit Chest, Arms, and Head of the user.

weapons.name: Pulse Laser Laserbeam
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Hardlight, Long barrel Special Rule. Secondary Armament of the UNSC G81 Condor.

weapons.name: Specialized Energy Charge SEC
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. EMP (6), Homing, Vehicle lock, Long barrel Special Rule. Secondary Armament of the M3063 Deployable Turret.

weapons.name: XEB9-Matos Nonlinear Pulse Cannon Matos
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. EMP (20) and Vehicle lock Special Rule. Blast (12), Kill (6). Holds 40 UNSC Battery Cells. A single shot will reduce one cell to empty.

weapons.name: Eos’Mak - Plasma Pistol Type-25 Directed Energy Pistol
weapons.description: [UD] [DW]. The Plasma Pistol has two firing modes, a semi-auto rapid fire and a single charged shot. Cauterize Special Rule. Built-in Covenant 2x Sight. When charging the Plasma Pistol, it may be released at any time. Each Half Action Charged, the Pistol’s Base Damage is increased by +5. The Pistol can be charged up to 3 Half Actions. When fully charged, the Charge can still be held longer, but will no longer increase the Base Damage. For every Half Action the Plasma Pistol charges, 5 Ammunition is consumed. Shots Charged for 3 Half Actions gain the EMP (4) Special Rule and the Homing Special Rule. When the Charged Shot is released, instantly gains Overheat (2).

weapons.name: Zo’klada - Plasma Pistol Type-54 Directed Energy Pistol
weapons.description: [UD] [DW]. The Plasma Pistol has two firing modes, a semi-auto rapid fire and a single charged shot. Cauterize Special Rule. Built-in Covenant 2x Sight. When charging the Plasma Pistol, it may be released at any time. Each Half Action Charged, the Pistol’s Base Damage is increased by +6. The Pistol can be charged up to 3 Half Actions. When fully charged, the Charge can still be held longer, but will no longer increase the Base Damage. For every Half Action the Plasma Pistol charges, 5 Ammunition is consumed. Shots Charged for 3 Half Actions gain the EMP (4) Special Rule and the Homing Special Rule. When the Charged Shot is released, instantly gains Overheat (2).

weapons.name: Paegaas - Spiker Type-25 Carbine
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Spike, Cauterize Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Jiralhanae Bayonet. The Spiker has a Jiralhanae Combat Knife bayonet.

weapons.name: Ukala - Mauler Type-52 Pistol
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize, Spread Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Jiralhanae Bayonet. The Mauler has a Jiralhanae Combat Knife bayonet. Fires the 7.9mm Bolt, but shatters as it is released.

weapons.name: Ukala Workshop – Mangler Spike Revolver
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Cauterize, Headshot Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Jiralhanae Bayonet.

weapons.name: Pelka’nan - Needle Pistol Type-33 Pistol
weapons.description: [UD] [DW]. Needle (4), Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Homing Special Rule below 50 Meters.

weapons.name: Okarda’phaa - Plasma Rifle Type-25 Directed Energy Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Firing 16 shots within two Rounds gains the Overheat (2) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Kewu R’shi’k - Plasma Rifle Type-25 Blood Hand Directed Energy Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Firing 12 shots within two Rounds gains the Overheat (2) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Kelos’vaarda - Storm Rifle Type-25 Directed Energy Rifle-Advanced
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Cauterize Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Firing 18 shots within two Rounds gains the Overheat (2) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Nakata’vho - Plasma Repeater Type-51 Directed Energy Rifle-Improved
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Cauterize Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Recharge (X). For every Round being fired consecutively, the Plasma Repeaters Rate of Fire is reduced by 2. For every Round being fired consecutively, the Plasma Repeaters Recharge gets +1, beginning at 0. Once the weapon stops firing, it must Recharge for however many Rounds it was firing for.

weapons.name: Erudo’ma’keth - Pulse Carbine Type-55 Directed Burst Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Cauterize, Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 4x Smartlink Scope. Firing 15 shots within three Half Actions gains the Overheat (5) Special Rule. The Player may use a Full Action to vent the Pulse Carbine to stop the weapon from Overheating any longer.

weapons.name: Wukrshuz - Particle Rifle Type-25 Advanced Particle Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Cauterize, Headshot Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 3x Smartlink Scope. Firing 16 shots within two Rounds gains the Overheat (3) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Nahle’Hax - Needler Type-33 Guided Munitions Launcher
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Needle (5), Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope.

weapons.name: Muket’lon - Needler Type-56 Guided Munitions Launcher
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Needle (5), Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope.

weapons.name: Gadulo - Needle Rifle Type-31 Needle Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Needle (3), Headshot Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 3x Smartlink Scope. Fires a High-velocity non-homing Blamite shard.

weapons.name: Vestige - Covenant Carbine Type-31 Carbine
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Headshot Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Fires radioactive caseless charges.

weapons.name: Vostu - Covenant Carbine Type-51 Carbine

weapons.name: Mosa - Covenant Carbine Type-57 Carbine
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Headshot Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 3x Smartlink Scope. Fires radioactive caseless charges. -5 Penalty To Hit when firing Automatic.

weapons.name: Bes’Ril’no - Gravity Rifle Type-31 Gravimetric Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Recharge (2), Cauterize, Gravity (1), Blast (4) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope.

weapons.name: Bet’a - Disintegrator Type-25 Directed Energy-Projector
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Flame (1D5), Cauterize, Spread Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Fires a spray of flaming plasma material that sticks to most surfaces. Releases a 45- degree cone of plasma that hits multiple targets. Point Blank Attacks with the Disintegrator causes the User to hit themselves with the Attack, as well.

weapons.name: Shepsu - Plasma Cannon Type-42 Directed Energy Support Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Tripod. Comes with a built-in 3.1 KG Tripod. This weapon can’t fire if removed from the tripod. The Tripod acts as a powerful generator that keeps the Plasma Cannon charged indefinitely.

weapons.name: Pi’lk - Plasma Cannon Type-44 Directed Energy Support Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Tripod. Comes with a 5.4 KG Anti-Gravity Tripod.

weapons.name: Gris - Plasma Cannon Type-46 Directed Energy Support Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Tripod. Comes with a 5.4 KG Anti-Gravity Tripod.

weapons.name: Pek - Plasma Cannon Type-52 Directed Energy Support Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope, Tripod. Comes with a 5.4 KG Anti-Gravity Tripod. Has an Energy Shield that protects the Head with a Shield Integrity of 50, a Recharge Rate of 50, and a Recharge Delay of 6.

weapons.name: Shea’p - Plasma Cannon Type-58 Directed Energy Support Weapon

weapons.name: Sulok - Particle Beam Rifle Type-50 Sniper Rifle System
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Penetrating, Kinetic, Headshot, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 4x-10x Smartlink Scope. If this weapon fires two times within a Half Action, it gains the Overheat (3) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Zubo - Beam Rifle Type-27 Special Application Sniper Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Penetrating, Kinetic, Headshot, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 5x-10x Smartlink Scope. If this weapon fires two times within a Half Action, it gains the Overheat (3) Special Rule.

weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Penetrating, Kinetic, Headshot, Long barrel Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 4x-10x Smartlink Scope. If this weapon fires at least once per Round, for two Rounds, the weapon gains the Overheat (3) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Jovokada - Death Lobber Type-25 Brute Shot Grenade Launcher
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (4), Kill (2) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope and Jiralhanae Bayonet. Shots ricochet off angled surfaces and explode at the beginning of the next Round or when a second surface is struck.

weapons.name: Jovokada - Death Lobber Type 2 Type-25B Brute Shot Grenade Launcher
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (4), Kill (2) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope and Jiralhanae Bayonet.

weapons.name: Flaktura Workshop Heavy Speargun Skewer
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Spike, Cauterize, Penetrating, Kinetic, Long barrel Special Rule. Impacted objects, vehicles, and Characters are thrown (X) Meters, where (X) is 25 meters, subtracted by 1 Meter for every 100kg it weighs.

weapons.name: Tufo’simi - Concussion Rifle Type-50 Heavy Rifle
weapons.description: [UD] [TH]. Cauterize, Gravity (2), Blast (2), Kill (1) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Uses detachable Plasma Battery Clips.

weapons.name: Kopasa’mada - Plasma Launcher Type-52 Guided Munitions Launcher
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Sticky, Cauterize, Blast (6), Kill (2), Homing, Vehicle lock Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Once the Plasma Grenades have made impact, the Grenades will detonate at the beginning of the Characters next Round.

weapons.name: Zasqi - Fuel Rod Gun Type-33 Light Anti-Armor Weapon Variant 1
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (5), Kill (2) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. Shots will detonate once they reach the 300 Meters. Firing 7 shots within two Rounds gains the Overheat (2) Special Rule.

weapons.name: Pez’tk - Fuel Rod Gun Type-33 Light Anti-Armor Weapon Variant 2
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (5), Kill (2), Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. If the weapon impacts under 15 meters, the Fuel Rods RadEXP shot will not explode, and will only gain Blast (1). If impacting further than 15 Meters, the shot gains Blast (5), Kill (2). Shots will detonate once they reach the 300 Meters. Homing Special Rule when within 100 Meters.

weapons.name: Korva - Fuel Rod Gun Type-33 Light Anti-Armor Weapon Variant 3
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (5), Kill (2), Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. If the weapon impacts under 15 meters, the Fuel Rods RadEXP shot will not explode, and will only gain Blast (1). If impacting further than 15 Meters, the shot gains Blast (5), Kill (2). Shots will detonate once they reach the 300 Meters. Homing Special Rule when within 100 Meters.

weapons.name: Gespu - Fuel Rod Gun Type-58 Light Anti-Armor Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (5), Kill (2) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope. If the weapon impacts or detonates under a 10 Meter Range, the Fuel Rods RadEXP shot will not explode, and will only gain Blast (1). If impacting further than 10 Meters, the shot gains Blast (5), Kill (2). Shots will detonate once they reach the 300 Meters.

weapons.name: Epleam - Beam Assault Cannon Type-33a Anti-Materiel-Personnel Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Flame (2D5), Cauterize Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope.

weapons.name: Epl’ast - Blast Assault Cannon Type-33b Anti-Materiel-Personnel Weapon
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (6), Kill (3) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope.

weapons.name: Epl’nm – Charged Assault Cannon Type-33c Anti-Materiel-Berserker’s Claw
weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Blast (10), Kill (4). Homing Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in Covenant 2x Smartlink Scope.

weapons.name: Anskum - Plasma Grenade Type-1 Antipersonnel Grenade
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Sticky, Cauterize, Blast (7), Kill (2) Special Rule. The Plasma Grenade can distinguish between targets and environment using heat signatures. The Plasma Grenade has a 6-second fuse. Once stuck, the grenade will detonate at the beginning of the Characters next Turn.

weapons.name: Orgudam - Firebomb Type-3 Antipersonnel-Antimateriel Incendiary Grenade
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Flame (1D10), Cauterize, Blast (10), Kill (1) Special Rule. Breaks on Impact and burns for three Rounds.

weapons.name: Jovokada - Spike Grenade Type-2 Antipersonnel Fragmentation Grenade
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Spike, Blast (8), Kill (2) Special Rule. Spike Special Rule when thrown. Melee attacks using this grenade share the Jiralhanae Combat Knifes Damage and Piercing. The Spike Grenade has a 6-second fuse. Once released, the grenade will detonate at the beginning of the Characters next Turn.

weapons.name: Riruku - Antimatter Grenade Type-4 Antipersonnel Grenade
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Blast (11), Kill (1) Special Rule. The Antimatter Grenade has a 6-second fuse. Once released, the grenade will detonate at the beginning of the Characters next Turn.

weapons.name: Slin-gasa - Covenant Charge Type-4 Door Charge
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize, Blast (6), Kill (2) Special Rule. Satchel Charge that explodes outward in one direction, only. Uses powerful adhesive to seal to any surface. Used to blow down doors and holes in walls. Safe to stand behind even during detonation. Blasts outward in a 45-degree cone shape. Cauterize Special Rule. Doubles Base Damage and Pierce against structures and surfaces.

weapons.name: Orepto - Plasma Charge Type-9 Ordnance
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize, Blast (10), Kill (2) Special Rule. Satchel Charge that explodes outward in one direction, only. Uses powerful adhesive to seal to any surface. Used to blow down doors and holes in walls. Safe to stand behind even during detonation. Blasts outward in a 45-degree cone shape. Cauterize Special Rule. Doubles Base Damage and Pierce against structures and surfaces.

weapons.name: Molitdem - Plasma Bomb Type-1 Ordnance
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize, Blast (20), Kill (15) Special Rule. Keypad-armed large explosive device. Comes with an armored Backpack with an Armor Rating of 6. An extremely powerful and large-range explosive that’s adjustable for time-based remote detonation. Creates powerful shockwaves up to 30 Meters. -20 Strength Test if inside Shockwave or take 1D10 Damage that ignores Armor and Toughness and fall Prone. Cauterize Special Rule. Doubles Base Damage and Pierce against structures and surfaces.

weapons.name: Tasndrap - Brute Landmine Type-2 Antimaterial Landmine
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Spike, Blast (9), Kill (5) Special Rule. Able to detonate from proximity and set timers. Can be detonated via proximity even when buried up to a meter deep. Launches 2 Meters into the air and then detonates. If launches under a vehicle or Character, the Brute Landmine gains the Spike Special Rule.

weapons.name: Lostro - Plasma Landmine Type-1 Proximity Trap
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize, Blast (12), Kill (2) Special Rule. Able to detonate from a 6 Meter proximity and set timers.

weapons.name: Standard Curveblade
weapons.description: [PD] [SD] [DW]. Covenant curved knife with a 25cm blade. -10 Penalty when throwing. Hand Guard gives a +4 Armor to Melee Attacks to the hand holding this weapon.

weapons.name: Sangheili Curveblade
weapons.description: [PD] [SD] [OH]. Enlarged curved knife with a 45cm blade. -10 Penalty when throwing. Hand Guard gives a +4 Armor to Melee Attacks to the hand holding this weapon.

weapons.name: Jiralhanae Combat Knife
weapons.description: [PD] [SD] [OH]. A large 55cm blade. -10 Penalty To Hit when throwing. Has a protective handguard that gives a 10 Armor Rating to Attacks against the hand wielding the blade.

weapons.name: Twin-Scythe
weapons.description: [PD] [SD] [OH]. An ancient, large 110cm dual blade. -20 Penalty To Hit when throwing. Can’t be used with two hands on Characters Normal Size Category and larger.

weapons.name: Trikala Pattern Spear
weapons.description: [PD] [SD] [TH] [HW]. An ancient, massive Sangheili polearm. Can only make one Attack per Half Action.

weapons.name: Qikost Pattern Burnblade
weapons.description: [PD] [SD] [OH]. Flame (1), Cauterize Special Rule. The rarity and status that comes from owning and using a Burnblade in Combat gives +10 to Social Skill Tests with other Covenant members.

weapons.name: Chiss-teh Pattern Painglass Saber
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Needle (2) Special Rule. Covenant estoc. Has an energy projector that houses thousands of shards of Subanese Crystals. With each successful hit, the Subanese Crystals are released into the Opponent. Once the weapon has made 30 successful Hits, it loses the Needle (2) Special Rule and can’t be repaired or recharged. Needle Special Rule does not Damage the User.

weapons.name: En'gore Pattern Energy Cutlass
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. A cutlass sword with a blade of Blamite-infused plasma. When an Attack is landed and deals Damage, the Cutlass gains the Needle (1) Special Rule and instantly detonates against the Target. The Energy Cutlass is not damaged or destroyed during this. A Thrust Attack can be made that is Slow Special Rule and instantly detonates the entire sword if it deals Damage to a Character, destroying it. This gives the Attack Needle (7) Special Rule and acts as if all 7 needed attacks have landed. Needle Special Rule does not Damage the User.

weapons.name: Akelus Workshop Gravity Hammer
weapons.description: [BD] [HW]. Slow, Stun (2D5+2), Gravity (4) Special Rule. When activated, the Gravity Hammer has the Gravity (4) Special Rule. The Gravity Hammer must physically hit for it to roll it to Activate. Any Character, except for the User, will be affected if they are still within the 4 Meter radius of the Hammers strike. Anyone behind the User is not affected by the Hammers Gravity Special Rule.

weapons.name: Pelotos Pattern Energy Dagger
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize Special Rule. Deactivates when not held. 46cm blade when activated. When this weapon is parried, this weapon will deal its Damage to that weapon’s Breakpoints unless that weapon shares this rule.

weapons.name: Domotos Pattern Energy Sword
weapons.description: [UD] [OH]. Cauterize Special Rule. Deactivates when not held. 128cm blade when activated. When this weapon is parried, this weapon will deal its Damage to that weapon’s Breakpoints unless that weapon shares this rule.

weapons.name: Vii’bold Pattern Energy Stave
weapons.description: [UD] [HW]. Slow and Cauterize Special Rule. Deactivates when not held. If attacking using this weapon when deactivated, it deals the Deactivated Type damage set. When this weapon is parried, this weapon will deal its Damage to that weapon’s Breakpoints unless that weapon shares this rule.

weapons.name: Thebetem Pattern Energy Lance
weapons.description: [UD] [HW]. Slow and Cauterize Special Rule. Deactivates when not held. A dual-sided Lance with a metal pole. If attacking using this weapon when deactivated, it deals the Deactivated Type damage set. If the User has the Modern Army Combative Ability, the User gains +1 to their total Melee Attacks per Full Action. When this weapon is parried, this weapon will deal its Damage to that weapon’s Breakpoints unless that weapon shares this rule.

weapons.name: Mistrom Pattern Point Defense Gauntlet
weapons.description: [BD] [OH]. A Shield that has a 1.2 Meter diameter and can cover 3 body locations on Normal sized Characters, where one must be the arm holding the Shield. Has a Shield Integrity of 225, a Recharge Rate of 225, and a Recharge Delay of 7. Gives an extra -10 Penalty To Hit when using with weapons that do not come with the [OH] Tag before modification. Slow Special Rule when used as a Melee Weapon. Adds +6 Damage to Punch Actions using the Gauntlet.

weapons.name: Murmifo Pattern Wrist Point Defense Gauntlet
weapons.description: [BD] [OH]. A set of two small wrist-mounted Shields for each wrist that cover one body location alongside the Forearm sublocations. Has a Shield Integrity of 225, a Recharge Rate of 225, and a Recharge Delay of 6. Adds +4 Damage to Punch Actions using the Gauntlet.

weapons.name: B’nall Pattern Sangheili Point Defense Gauntlet
weapons.description: [BD] [OH]. A Shield that has a 1.5 Meter diameter and can cover 3 body locations on Large sized Characters, where one must be the arm holding the Shield. Has a Shield Integrity of 225, a Recharge Rate of 225, and a Recharge Delay of 7. Slow Special Rule when used as a Melee Weapon. Adds +8 Damage to Punch Actions using the Gauntlet.

weapons.name: Ratent Pattern Hunter Heavy Metal Shield
weapons.description: [BD] [HW]. Kinetic, Stun (2D5+6) Special Rule. provides 50 Armor and has 1000 Breakpoints. The Heavy Metal Shield can’t be Parried and can only swing once per Half Action by a Mgalekgolo, or once per Full Action by any other Soldier Type. The Hunter Shield covers 3 Locations on Hulking size Characters.

weapons.name: Paegaas Workshop Combat Shield
weapons.description: [BD] [TH]. Provides 20 Armor and has 250 Breakpoints. A hidden circular shield that replaces the gauntlet of the armor being worn. Takes one Half Action to fold out and back in. The shield can protect the Arm using the Shield alongside two chosen Body Locations on Large Characters.

weapons.description: [UD] [TH] [HW]. Cauterize, Blast (4) Special Rule. Primary Armament of the Covenant Phantom vehicles.
